arguments.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t INNER JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate across all labelled transactions, as a fraction between 0 and 1.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only (inner join to fraud_labels); unlabelled transactions (about 33% of the total) are excluded, not counted as legitimate.
The full data period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 is included.
